 We’re a proud industry pioneer with over 20 years of experience accelerating the ad technology evolution. With our radically transparent business practices and dedication to total market efficiency, we’re committed to upholding the integrity of the programmatic ecosystem at large.
   

  

**What’s it like to work at Index?**
 Index is an exciting and fast\-paced place to work. You'll be able to feed your ambition, lean into trust and transparency, and feel genuine support from your colleagues. We’re built on our core values and live them each day. They're‌ not just buzzwords.
   

  

 We pride ourselves on our independence and openness, not only in our technology, but in our teams, too. Our diverse and inclusive culture celebrates how we can leverage our unique differences to help drive Index forward.
   

  

 We have more than 550 Indexers around the globe dedicated to building a safe and transparent marketplace that provides a trusted experience for consumers, and we’re looking for talented professionals to help take us to the next level.
   

  

**Are you ready to join the programmatic evolution?**
 Index Exchange is looking for a Senior Product Manager who combines vision with practicality to steer our Machine Learning and Optimization (MLO) initiatives. Every day, our exchange manages billions of ad transactions. This creates an abundance of data and complexity that challenges even the most robust reporting systems and data\-driven analysis. As the Product Manager, you'll grapple with crucial problems such as identifying the impressions most likely to be purchased by different buyers, devising solutions for price prediction, and overcoming auction flooring challenges.
   

  

 Candidates should bring substantial hands\-on experience from technical environments, specifically in working with Data Science and Engineering teams to bring Machine Learning (ML) based features to market. A robust foundation in Statistics or Mathematics will support your work in the intricate field of Machine Learning. You'll be trusted to cultivate and expand our team's skill set from day one.
   

  

 You will find yourself in high\-visibility, high\-stakes settings, where your capacity to guide projects from concept to completion with minimal supervision and exceptional project management skills will be central to your success. While prior experience in ad tech – with a solid understanding of programmatic advertising, DSPs, buyers, publishers, etc. – will equip you to hit the ground running, we also welcome candidates with experience in financial markets or pricing, such as airline yield management. Your inclination towards working with big data platforms and launching analytics and reporting products to market will add to your appeal.
   

  

 Our ideal candidate is someone who flourishes in data\-rich environments, communicates superbly, and navigates efficiently across various time zones. If you're a numbers whizz who loves delving into complex technical challenges, and you're keen to create innovative products for our 3,000 publisher clients, this role could be your perfect fit.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
**Platform Thinking**
* You think in platforms, not one\-offs. You identify patterns across problems and design scalable, generic solutions that solve them broadly.
* You understand how to balance flexibility and standardization, and you build for long\-term leverage while solving immediate customer needs.


**Technical Curiosity \& Depth**
* You bring a strong technical acumen — not to design systems yourself, but to deeply understand how they work.
* You’re naturally curious about AI/ML, distributed systems, and ad exchanges, and you dive into details to ensure solutions are not just shipped, but shipped right.
* You partner seamlessly with Data Science and Engineering, asking the right questions, spotting gaps, and holding the bar high for quality and accountability.


**Strong Communication \& Leadership Presence**
* You are a natural communicator — clear, confident, and adaptable whether it’s 1:1 with engineers, presenting to executives, or engaging with clients.
* You assert yourself as a leader in the room: not a spectator, but an active voice who drives clarity and alignment.
* You inspire confidence across teams and are comfortable representing Index externally.


**Opinionated Problem\-Solver**
* You don’t just surface problems — you come to the table with solutions.
* You understand systems and constraints deeply enough to form strong, well\-reasoned opinions about how to move forward.
* You bring those opinions confidently into upward and cross\-functional discussions, shaping the direction of the product rather than acting as a passive communication channel.


**Ownership \& Proactiveness**
* You treat your product area as a business within the business. You organize complex problem spaces, define priorities, and own outcomes.
* You proactively manage up and across, providing crisp updates and flagging risks before they become problems.
* You anticipate the next 5 steps, think through edge cases, and rally cross\-functional teams to stay ahead of blockers.


**Analytical Sharpness \& Judgment**
* You don’t need to be a Data Scientist, but you’re highly data\-literate: comfortable with SQL, interpreting experiments, and spotting when numbers look “off.”
* You have strong product intuition, backed by the ability to pressure\-test assumptions with data.
* You develop a spidey sense for when something isn’t right, dig deeper, and help steer teams away from dead ends early.


**Organized, Written\-First Operator**
* You are highly organized and use structured writing to bring clarity of thought and drive alignment across teams and stakeholders.
* You synthesize problems into clear roadmaps, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* You think through not only what to build, but also how to release, measure, and monitor ML products, features, and capabilities at exchange scale.


**Here’s What You’ll Be Doing**
* Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to design and deliver ML\-driven optimization products.
* Translate complex system behavior into clear product requirements, project roadmaps, and acceptance criteria.
* Apply platform thinking to identify common patterns and constraints, designing scalable solutions that benefit multiple use cases.
* Analyze experiments, model outputs, and business impact to validate hypotheses and guide iteration.
* Collaborate with commercial teams and customers to identify problems worth solving and align incentives across the ecosystem.
* Launch and own features end\-to\-end: from strategy and requirements to go\-to\-market and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Define success metrics, monitor live performance, and ensure ML features scale reliably across billions of transactions.
* Be the connective tissue between internal stakeholders and external customers, ensuring that what we build delivers real value.


**Here's What You Need**
* 5\+ years of Product Management experience in ad tech platforms, auctions, yield management, pricing, forecasting, advanced modeling, machine learning, or AI.

* A track record of successful 0\-1 product launches and landings

* Experience in operating and maintaining analytical instruments such as LI\-COR gas analyzers, TGAs, vacuum systems, and high\-temperature reactors.
* Experience in mineral activation technologies (thermal, microwave, chemical, and mechanical) across diverse feedstocks and process conditions.
* Familiarity with interpreting data from ICP\-OES, X\-ray diffraction, dynamic closed chambers, and coulometric titration.
* Trained in comminution (crushing and grinding), safe forklift operation, and handling of industrial\-scale mineral feedstocks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to summarize experimental data to nontechnical audiences.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently on multiple experiments concurrently and coordinate effectively within a fast\-paced R\&D environment.

**25WD89433, Principal Data Scientist**
*French translation to follow!/Traduction française à suivre*
**Position Overview**
 Autodesk customers make sense of the world through rich streams of data \- from 3D scans of buildings and fluid dynamic simulations to field notes from construction sites and product usage trends. We are looking for a Principal Data Scientist to join Autodesk’s Platform Strategy and Emerging Technologies (PSET) organization and use their experience in AI/ML and Data Science to develop the next generation of applied AI solutions that power our platform and enable smarter, scalable and cost\-efficient experiences for our customers.
   

  

 As a Principal Data Scientist on our Platform Strategy and Emerging Technologies (PSET) \- Programs \& Business Excellence (PBE) team, you will play a key role in advancing the data science and AI capabilities within the company. You will serve as a subject matter expert, guiding the development and deployment of machine learning models and data driven solutions that support strategic platform capabilities. In this role, you will partner with cross\-functional teams – including data scientists, data analysts, product managers, engineers and domain experts to deliver innovative solutions that drive business impact. This role requires a combination of strong technical expertise, leadership abilities, and business acumen to address complex challenges and influence strategic decisions. You will report to the Senior Manager of Data Science, PSET.
   

  

 Preference for candidates to work hybrid/remote in Toronto or Montreal, Canada.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to translate complex business challenges into testable hypotheses and impactful data science solutions
* Develop \& deploy end\-to\-end AI/ML pipelines, by partnering with data engineers and contribute from data preprocessing to model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring
* Design and implement advanced statistical \& experimentation frameworks, including post\-launch causal inference techniques (e.g. A/B testing, propensity score matching) to measure product impact
* Lead the exploration and application of Generative AI to develop scalable solutions \- such as AI assistants to support platform capabilities
* Build classic machine learning applications such as personalization, recommendation, and ranking systems to improve customer workflows and drive product adoption
* Mentor and guide junior data scientists, conduct technical reviews, and promote best practices in experimentation, model development, and MLOps
* Collaborate with a team of data scientists in developing AI/ML models and solutions over large\-scale data that address business problems and drive product innovation
* Translate insights into actionable recommendations, effectively guiding business strategy through clear communication with cross\-functional teams
* Advanced expert role, requiring deep subject\-matter knowledge and sound business acumen to advise leaders
* For jobs at this level, knowledge of the business starts to become as important as subject\-matter knowledge
* Incumbents translate specialized subject\-matter requirements into business needs/requirements
* Require depth of specialized expertise to interpret internal/external business issues and recommend best practices to address them
* Solve complex problems that require in\-depth evaluation of variable factors by taking a broad perspective to identify the best approach and innovative solutions.
* Work independently, with close guidance in only the most complex or unusual situations
* Adapt communication style to persuade various stakeholders across the business and frequently interact with senior leaders to provide advice and SME
* May lead functional teams or programs within own function (or closely related functions)


**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or AI, with a proven track record of delivering successful AI\-driven solutions at scale
* Expertise in developing and deploying machine learning models, particularly in large\-scale environments, with a focus on deep learning, reinforcement learning, or natural language processing
* Proficient with various statistical and machine learning techniques including classification, regression, dimension reduction, regularization, clustering and various multivariate methods

* Experience working with cloud environments like AWS and leveraging its offerings such as Lambda Bedrock, SageMaker, etc

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying AI models for real\-time applications in manufacturing or construction
* Strong knowledge base of MLOps practices for efficient model deployment and scaling
* Proven leadership and mentorship experience, with a passion for developing and inspiring high\-performing teams

We believe our community\-centric platform has created the opportunity for Reddit to build a highly differentiated ads business.

 The Ads Data Science team at Reddit leverages data to maximize advertiser value on Reddit through robust data foundations, metrics, and strategic insights generated through experimentation and cutting\-edge DS methods.

We are a highly collaborative team of passionate data scientists and engineers who are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with machine learning and statistical modeling.

 The Office of Management Analysis and Planning (OMAP) analyzes and evaluates Departmental policies, programs, and resources to make recommendations to the Police Commissioner in order to ensure maximum organizational efficiency and effectiveness of the Department. OMAP is the research and assessment arm of the Department, comprised of both uniformed and civilian members of the service with a wide variety of academic and professional experiences. OMAP serves as the primary evaluation and assessment arm of the NYPD. ------------------

Our investment plan proposes a doubling of investment over the next five years, and a large proportion of this is in wastewater.

* degree qualified or equivalent, possibly with chartered engineer or equivalent status
* excellent oral and written communication skills
* personal skills that enable effective working with people at all levels
